result.summary: Found 1 visually broken issue: a meaningless '-0%' discount badge on the pizza card in the 'Popular right now' section.

issues.description: The discount badge on the second card under 'Popular right now' (pizza image) displays '-0%', which is a meaningless negative-zero discount and looks like a broken placeholder/calculation.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount is 0%, or fix the discount calculation/formatting so it only shows a valid positive discount value.
